direction.concept: Seasoned expedition guide through difficult information terrain.
direction.summary: Calm adult Australian English expedition guide: grounded, experienced, precise, evidence-first, quietly confident.

accent.rendering: Natural and regionally Australian, the way an experienced local sounds on a field recording. Never performed as a gimmick.

providerBindings.note: Provider-specific settings live here, never in a VideoSpec, and never a voice id: a provider interprets the direction above with its own controls. Credentials are read from the environment at synthesis time only and are never written to manifests. The narration bakeoff's evaluation bindings (voice ids, pinned models, named variants) live in config/narration-providers.json; the publication binding below stays NOT_CONFIGURED until a provider is promoted.
